comments.author: @naz95k71
comments.text:
important info------------------------

-the rotor uses honda pattern, you can slap on a 320mm rotor if youd like.

-the fork accepts dirtbike calipers, you can slap on a crf450 brembo caliper, larger and thicker brake pads, and just feels soooo much better.

-you realy should upgrade the jackshaft to something with better bearings, and a lubing port.

-upgrade the belt drive to a wider belt and use the best belt out there.

-change the chain to an mx racing one, aka without ORINGS. you will get much smoother power, and 0,5-2hp more.

-a controler upgrade for smoother power delivery and tuning imo is a must. PLUS you sudenly can put a third lever on the bike, and set it up like a clutch, or just an E brake, you save on pads, and regen power into the batery. more power is nice, but power delivery and the extra features is a much bigger impact

i could go on and on about mods, but these are the ones id recomend you do the most. it will make the bike much more crazy good.
